english.title: Participated in an unauthorised competition / trial using a motor vehicle on a public way
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) took part in a competition or trial involving the use of motor vehicles on a public way, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC WAY AND LOCATION..), when the said competition or trial was not authorised and was not conducted in accordance with conditions imposed by or under the Motor Vehicles (Competitions and Trials) Regulations 1969
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording only applies to unauthorised races or trials of speed. See H3044 for the offence wording relating to authorised races or competitions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also the associated offence wording as follows: H3045.
(iv) In the Statement of Facts specify whether the defendant took part as a driver, passenger, timekeeper or steward or give details of the nature of the promotion and give details of speeds reached and danger caused to other road users.
